fusions.name: Gale Sweep
fusions.desc: A cone of wind that deals 9 damage to everything caught in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballast Dart
fusions.desc: A thrown sting that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times its damage at maximum range. Its damage rises 10% per tile you have travelled, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Swell Riding
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
